interface.title: GelAnnotate v0.1.0
interface.field: Molecular biology / biochemistry (gel electrophoresis, western blots)
interface.stage_of_work: Data presentation: turning a raw gel or blot photo into a labelled figure ready for publication
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a gel or blot photo, find the lanes, label them in one or more tiers, match the molecular-weight ladder bands to the vendor's sizes, and export the annotated figure at journal resolution.

data.note: Most of the work used western-blot.png (960x587 px). It found 15 lanes on its own. With a Color Prestained Broad Range protein ladder assigned to lane 7, 9 of 12 bands were measured and the fit gave r²=0.9993. A shorter run used agarose-gel-dna.jpg (858x1024 colour photo) with the DNA (bp) / GeneRuler 100 bp ladder. Automatic detection found only 5 lanes there and missed the real ladder lane, and with lane 2 as the standard 4 of 10 bands were measured (r²=0.9995). Neither stock image has a true ladder lane, so these match counts are not meaningful.

features.name: 1-D peak detection over an image with an overlay and a profile plot
features.general: Crop the search to the region of interest, collapse an image into a column profile, find peaks either freely or as an evenly spaced comb of N teeth, and show the result as an overlay on the image above the profile with marked peaks
features.specific: Lane detection: Number of lanes (0 = auto), 'Lanes are equally spaced' comb fit, Detection settings (Columns to search / Rows to measure to crop to the gel, peak prominence, band polarity, flatten illumination, rotation correction), Detect lanes, then the shaded-lane overlay and the background-subtracted lane-signal plot
steps: Load the image (detection runs automatically with count 0)
For a photographed gel, crop the search to the gel with Columns to search / Rows to measure in Detection settings, so the tray background is not taken for lanes (not tried in this run)
Optionally adjust prominence/polarity in Detection settings
Type a lane count and choose equal spacing (comb fit) or free peaks
Press Detect lanes and check the overlay, the profile peaks and the per-lane score table
serves_tasks: Force a known number of columns

features.name: Editable table of detected positions with an explicit apply step
features.general: Show automatically found positions as a table where you can nudge values, delete rows or add rows, then commit the edits so the rest of the tool uses them
features.specific: Lanes tab data editor (lane, center_px, score): edit center_px, tick a row and press the trash icon, + to add a row (not tried), then Apply lane edits
steps: Type a new value into a position cell
Tick a row's selector and press the trash icon to drop it
Press Apply lane edits
Check the redrawn overlay and the new lane count
serves_tasks: Correct the detected columns by hand

features.name: Per-item label grid with several tiers and a live figure preview
features.general: Enter text for each item in a spreadsheet-like grid with columns for 'above', 'below' and up to three extra lower rows, and watch the figure preview update as you type
features.specific: Annotation tab Lane fields grid (lane, above, below, row 2 below, row 3 below, row 4 below) next to the Preview
steps: Type a label in the 'above' column for each lane
Move with the arrow keys to the 'below' column and type
Fill 'row 2 below' / 'row 3 below' / 'row 4 below' for extra tiers
Check the labels in the Preview
serves_tasks: Write a label above and below each sample
Add extra rows of labels below the samples

features.name: Reference-standard calibration: detect peaks, match them to known values and fill gaps from a fitted model
features.general: Pick a reference preset (or define a custom one) and the column that holds it, detect its peaks, match them to the stated values, fill unresolved ones from a fitted calibration curve, and report how many were measured and the r²
features.specific: Standard type (Protein kDa / DNA bp / RNA nt / Custom with a set field count and unit) + Ladder preset in the sidebar; in the Markers tab, 'Standard is in lane', Band sensitivity, Rows to search, 'Find bands in this lane', the status line 'N of M bands measured … (r²=…)', and the 'Show the band fit' plot (solid = measured, dashed = placed from the mobility model)
steps: Choose Standard type and Ladder (note the 'not vendor-verified' warning); for an unlisted ladder, Custom sets the number of marker fields and the unit (not tried)
Choose the lane that holds the standard
Optionally adjust Band sensitivity and Rows to search
Press Find bands in this lane and read the measured count and r²
Expand Show the band fit to check measured vs. modelled bands
serves_tasks: Choose the reference standard that was used
Detect the reference bands and match them to known sizes

features.name: Two-anchor manual placement of a scale
features.general: Place every tick of a known scale by giving only the image positions of the first and last values; the ticks in between are interpolated
features.specific: Place bands by hand instead: Top band row (px), Bottom band row (px), Place bands
steps: Expand Place bands by hand instead
Type the top and bottom band rows
Press Place bands (press again if nothing changes)
Check the recomputed row (px) column and the preview ticks, including any row you set by hand earlier, which may be kept rather than interpolated
serves_tasks: Place the reference scale from two anchor points instead

features.name: Per-tick review table (position, label, visibility)
features.general: Review each calibration tick in a table and override its position, change its text, or hide it, before trusting the result
features.specific: Marker table (band, value, label, row (px), show): edit row (px) to nudge a marker, edit label, untick show to hide it
steps: Compare each row (px) against the band fit or the lot sheet
Type a corrected row (px)
Untick show for markers you don't want printed
Check the change in the preview
serves_tasks: Check and adjust individual reference positions by hand

features.name: Scale-drawing and text-layout options with live preview
features.general: Set how the calibration scale is drawn (side, ticks, unit, emphasis of reference values), add a title and caption, and choose font size, width and label rotation, all shown live in the preview
features.specific: Marker display (Side, Tick marks, Print unit next to the top band, Bold the reference bands); Text and layout (Title, Caption, Font size, Figure width, Rotate labels above/below)
steps: Choose the marker side and tick/unit/bold options
Type a title (and caption)
Drag the label rotation and set font size or figure width
Check the result in the preview
serves_tasks: Choose how the size scale is drawn
Add a title and set the label layout

features.name: Image display adjustments with live preview
features.general: Change how the underlying image is rendered in the figure (invert, percentile contrast stretch, shading of detected items, border) without altering the data, and see it live in the preview
features.specific: Image display: Invert, Stretch contrast 0.5–99.5 percentile, Shade detected lanes, Border
steps: Tick Stretch contrast (and Invert for a dark-background image)
Tick Shade detected lanes to check lane positions
Untick shading again before export
Check the result in the preview
serves_tasks: Adjust how the image itself is displayed

features.name: Figure export: save to a server path at a set format and dpi, or download
features.general: Choose an output path, file format and resolution, write the figure, and get a confirmation; or download a copy directly
features.specific: Save tab: Output path, Format (png/tif/pdf/svg/jpg), Resolution (dpi), Save ('Saved to …' message), Download instead
steps: Choose a format
Type an output path with a matching extension (Format alone does not change the path)
Set the dpi (default 600)
Press Save and read the confirmation, or press Download instead
serves_tasks: Write a high-resolution file for the journal
